# Just One More Bite (JOMB)

> Just One More Bite (JOMB) is a chef-made weekly meal delivery service in Raleigh, North Carolina, run by Executive Chef Michael Saunders. Every week JOMB writes a new Zone, Paleo, Low-Carb Dairy-Free and Family menu, cooks it from scratch in Raleigh, and delivers it on Tuesday to homes, offices and CrossFit gyms. JOMB also offers protein by the pound, private chef dinners, catering and weddings.

## Key facts
- Chef: Chef Michael Saunders, Executive Chef and owner. Formerly Executive Sous Chef, Morton's The Steakhouse (Dallas, TX); Executive Chef, The Ore House (Steamboat Springs, CO); Executive Chef, Oryx (Raleigh, NC).
- New menu posted every Wednesday evening. Order by Saturday at 8 PM. Delivered Tuesday, 10 AM – 5 PM.
- Delivery area: Raleigh, Cary, Morrisville, Research Triangle Park (RTP) and Knightdale (North Carolina). Delivered to homes, offices and CrossFit gyms.
- Phone: (919) 443-5408 · Email: jomborders@gmail.com · Order online: https://www.justonemorebitenc.com/jomb-store
- Prices (before tax): Zone $253 for 18 meals ($14.05/meal); Low-Carb Dairy-Free lunches $12.50, dinners $18.00; Paleo lunches $14.50, dinners $19.50; Family dinner $75 (feeds 3).
